snippet.title: FBC: Firebreak Launch Trailer and interview with Game Director Mike Kayatta  - PC Gaming Show 2025
snippet.description:
Sticky note monsters, flying staplers, traffic lights, and flaming teapots. We sat down with the Game Director of FBC: Firebreak, Mike Kayatta, to find out all the juicy details on this upcoming co-op shooter from Remedy Entertainment.

FBC: Firebreak launches on June 17th:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272540/FBC_Firebreak?snr=1_614_615_pcgamingshow2025_100703
